body: Sorry for the delay, here my testing using test project: [ruby-test.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/27568001/ruby-test.zip) ## Misaligned The alignment is off when re-opening, or playing, the scene. Requires a text edit to fix: https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/9e532bb2-8c39-480a-82fb-6e4fa659c998 ## Center vs Center-Center not sure if `center` (`INLINE_ALIGNMENT_CENTER`) and `center,center` (`INLINE_ALIGNMENT_CENTER_TO|INLINE_ALIGNMENT_TO_CENTER`) are supposed look different (at least without overflowing they are identical): ``` # upper richtextlabel 前に[table=1,center,1,1,l][cell][font_size=64]とうじょう[/font_size][/cell][cell][color=red]登場[/color][/cell][/table]はここ # lower richtextlabel 前に[table=1,center,center,1,1,l][cell][font_size=64]とうじょう[/font_size][/cell][cell][color=red]登場[/color][/cell][/table]はここ ``` ## Not left-aligned if text is at start I reckon you meant this cutoff, if the text is at the start and not left-aligned when you said the following: > […] not perfect, and do require manual alignment if it's not in the middle of text […] - [godotengine/godot#105795](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/105795)
